relations.note: Basajaun substitutes for or represents Gaueko as the nocturnal abductor.
relations.source: Lower Navarre/Beyrie oral versions summarized by Barandiarán

relations.note: Jentilak abduct Kattalin and proclaim Gaueko’s night-rule as his interpreted instruments.
Witches seize María and recite the formula assigning night to night-beings.
The Devil replaces Gaueko’s nocturnal-abductor role in Christianized variants.
relations.source: Beyrie oral variants collected by Barandiarán
